decisions.reason: Presented on its own page and close to the established offer, it signals substantial investment and public commitment, so escalation makes dropping unlikely.
Only mentioned on the website, it has little public commitment and likely modest investment, so after four years management is more likely to drop it.
Its own page and closeness to the established offer show visible commitment, so the firm tends to persist with it.
Like C, it received only a mention and little visible investment, and with results no longer easily attributed to temporary causes, dropping is probable.
